IN THE COURT OF APPEALS OF THE STATE OF OREGON
Jose F. Rodriguez-Alcaraz,
Petitioner,
v.
Board of Parole and Post-Prison Supervision,
Respondent.
Court of Appeals No. A186445
ORDER REACTIVATING JUDICIAL REVIEW; VACATING AND
REMANDING; APPELLATE JUDGMENT
Before Egan, Presiding Judge, and Joyce, Judge.
The parties jointly move to reactivate this case, which was held in abeyance
pending this court’s decision in Harless v. Board of Parole, 348 Or App 289, ___ P3d
___ (2026). They further move the court to vacate the board’s final order setting
petitioner’s sex offender classification and remand the case in light of Harless.1 The
motion is granted.
The court agrees with the parties that the proper disposition of this case is to
vacate the board’s order and remand for a new assessment of petitioner’s sex offender
notification level, pursuant to Harless. The court further agrees that summary
disposition is appropriate in this case.
Vacated and remanded.
James C. Egan
Presiding Judge
6/1/2026
1 A copy of the parties’ motion, for the board’s review, is available on the court’s
Appellate Case Management System (ACMS).
